
# Price Quality 5

The price quality used for the calculation of the value of the position.

* EOD - end of day price
* REALTIME - realtime price
* DELAYED - delayed price
* NA - no available price

## Enumeration

`PriceQuality5`

## Fields

|  --- |

| `Realtime` |
